title: Take the promotions out of Checkout

task.text: Every new promotion is another branch in `Checkout`.
Refactor so a new promotion is a new **strategy**, not an edit to `Checkout`. `Pricing.total(code, prices)` must keep returning exactly what it returns now.

items: Add `interface DiscountPolicy` with one method, `BigDecimal apply(BigDecimal subtotal)`.
`Checkout(DiscountPolicy)` sums the prices, delegates, and rounds to 2 places.
Resolve codes in `Discounts.forCode(String)`; unknown codes throw `IllegalArgumentException`.

checks.title: Known codes give the same totals
A flat discount never goes below zero
Checkout holds a private final policy
Checkout accepts a policy it has never seen

hints.text: Find what varies: the rule that turns a subtotal into a total. `Checkout` should only know that *some* rule does that. Give that rule a name.
Give `Checkout` a `private final DiscountPolicy` set in its constructor. The string code belongs where policies are chosen, not where they are used.
